phases.description: Monorepo scaffold (pnpm + Turborepo), Better Auth on the shared mi7rab auth database, Drizzle schema and migrations, Docker Compose for local Postgres, and Cloud Run deployment on the umbrella's shared-infra model.
phases.label: PHASE 0
phases.name: Foundation

phases.description: The workout loop itself: programs to days to sessions, logged sets across four exercise kinds, personal records, the muscle/equipment taxonomy and curated catalog, fuel and body tracking, the theme system, and freeform off-program sessions.
phases.label: PHASE 1
phases.name: Core loop
phases.summary: Programs, sessions, PRs, taxonomy, fuel, body, theming

phases.description: Make every write visible and every number honest. No mutation may fail silently, no tap may log twice, no destructive action may fire without confirmation, and no historical row may be rewritten by a later edit to the program that produced it.
phases.label: PHASE 2
phases.name: Trust
phases.summary: Every write visible, every number honest

phases.description: Nutrition moves off the bottom of Start onto its own Fuel tab. Scope, decided 2026-09-26: track protein, calories, carbs and fat, with carbs and fat optional on every entry so a blank stays a blank; foods come from a personal food memory (the user's own items and units, never a food database or barcodes, per PROJECT_RECOMMENDATIONS.md); logging any day; a weekly view that leaves unlogged days out of the average; and an expenditure estimate that never moves the target on its own. Mockup (deleted; this text is the spec)
phases.label: PHASE 3b
phases.name: Fuel page
phases.summary: A full nutrition page: four macros, saved foods, portions, any day, weekly view

phases.description: The active-workout surface, judged by tap count, touch-target size, and recovery from a mistake rather than the happy path. This is the highest-frequency screen in the app and the one most often used one-handed with a barbell waiting.
phases.label: PHASE 3
phases.name: Active loop
phases.summary: Taps, targets, and recovery on the session screen

phases.description: Capabilities the data model already half-supports: more than one program, back-dated sessions, validated request bodies, a database-backed test setup, and a screen that makes the exercise library reachable.
phases.label: PHASE 4
phases.name: Depth
phases.summary: Multiple programs, back-dating, validation, tests, library

phases.description: What the data can say that you did not already know: per-muscle volume, whole-workout trends, deterministic progression suggestions, a readiness signal from sleep and resting HR, and bodyweight read next to strength. Deterministic rules over data already held, never a model.
phases.label: PHASE 5
phases.name: Insight

phases.description: Debt with a known shape: an N+1 in the session payload, a function duplicated across two routes, check-then-act races that gate any future multi-device work, installability, and documentation that has drifted from what shipped.
phases.label: PHASE 6
phases.name: Upkeep
